name: Resilience4j Circuit Breaker Configuration
description: JSON structure for Resilience4j CircuitBreaker configuration.

fields.name: slidingWindowType
fields.description: Type of sliding window used to record calls.

fields.name: slidingWindowSize
fields.description: Size of the sliding window (calls or seconds).

fields.name: minimumNumberOfCalls
fields.description: Minimum calls before error rate calculation.

fields.name: failureRateThreshold
fields.description: Failure rate percentage to open the circuit.

fields.name: slowCallRateThreshold
fields.description: Slow call rate percentage to open the circuit.

fields.name: slowCallDurationThreshold
fields.description: Duration after which a call is considered slow.

fields.name: waitDurationInOpenState
fields.description: Time the circuit stays open before trying half-open.

fields.name: permittedNumberOfCallsInHalfOpenState
fields.description: Number of calls permitted in half-open state.

fields.name: automaticTransitionFromOpenToHalfOpenEnabled
fields.description: Enable automatic transition from OPEN to HALF_OPEN.

fields.name: baseConfig
fields.description: Shared configuration name to inherit from (instances only).
